01

“And in whatever you differ about, its judgment is [referred] to God”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:10).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And in whatever you differ about, its judgment is [referred] to God [al-Shura 10] He says: "He judges in it."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا اخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ فَحُكْمُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ [الشورى: 10] يَقُولُ: «يَحْكُمُ فِيهِ»
Edition record 373287 · p. 588Link to report ↗
02

“He multiplies you thereby”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:11).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
He multiplies you thereby [al-Shura 11] meaning: "generation after generation."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ [الشورى: 11] ، يَعْنِي: «نَسْلًا بَعْدَ نَسْلٍ»
Edition record 373288 · p. 588Link to report ↗

Explanation from Mujāhid 03

04

“He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:13).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah [al-Shura 13] He says: "He enjoined it upon you, O Muhammad, and upon all His prophets: Islam as one religion."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا [الشورى: 13] يَقُولُ: «أَوْصَاكَ بِهِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ وَأَنْبِيَاءَهُ كُلَّهُمْ بِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَاحِدًا»
Edition record 373290 · p. 588Link to report ↗
05
Explanation from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
God chooses for Himself whom He wills [al-Shura 13] he said: "God, Mighty and Majestic, says: He selects for Himself whom He wills."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَجْتَبِي إِلَيْهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ [الشورى: 13] قَالَ: «يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عز وجل يَسْتَخْلِصُ لِنَفْسِهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ»
Edition record 373291 · p. 588Link to report ↗

الإسناد

06

“And those who argue concerning God after He has been responded to”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:16).

07
Explanation from Mujāhid 07

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
And those who argue concerning God after He has been responded to [al-Shura 16] he said: "Some men hoped that the pre-Islamic period would return."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَالَّذِينَ يُحَاجُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا اسْتُجِيبَ لَهُ [الشورى: 16] قَالَ: «طَمَعَ رِجَالٌ أَنْ تَعُودَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةُ»

09

“Say, 'I do not ask you for it any payment except affection for…”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 42:23).

10
Explanation from Mujāhid 10

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
Say, 'I do not ask you for it any payment except affection for [my] kinship' [al-Shura 23] He says: "except that you follow me, believe me, and maintain ties with my relatives and my kin."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
قُلْ لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا إِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِي الْقُرْبَى [الشورى: 23] يَقُولُ: «إِلَّا أَنْ تَتَّبِعُونِيَ وَتُصَدِّقُونِي وَتَصِلُوا قَرَابَتِي وَرَحِمِي»
Edition record 373296 · p. 589Link to report ↗
11
Report from Ibn ʿAbbās 11

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Sharik related to us, from Khusayf, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
The Messenger of God ﷺ said to them: "I do not ask you for it ⦗p. 590⦘ any payment except that you have affection for me for the sake of my kinship, and that you preserve the kinship between me and you."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا شَرِيكُ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
«لَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ ⦗ص: 590⦘ أَجْرًا إِلَّا أَنْ تَوَدُّونِي فِي نَفْسِي لِقَرَابَتِي وَتَحْفَظُوا لِيَ الْقَرَابَةَ الَّتِي بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ»
Edition record 373297 · p. 589Link to report ↗

English
Transmission wording

14

“But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation”

An explanation transmitted from al-Ḥasan (Q 42:40).

18
Explanation from al-Ḥasan 18

al-Ḥasan

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: al-Mubarak ibn Fudala related to us, from al-Hasan, on His words:
But whoever pardons and makes reconciliation [al-Shura 40] he said: "When the nations kneel before God, Mighty and Majestic, a caller will call: 'Let everyone whose reward is with God stand.' None will stand except those who pardoned in the world."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
فَمَنْ عَفَا وَأَصْلَحَ [الشورى: 40] قَالَ: «إِذَا جَثَتِ الْأُمَمُ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ عز وجل نَادَى مُنَادٍ لِيَقُمْ كُلُّ مَنْ كَانَ أَجْرُهُ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَلَا يَقُومُ إِلَّا مَنْ عَفَا فِي الدُّنْيَا»
Edition record 373304 · p. 591Link to report ↗

English

“you will have no refuge that Day”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:47).

20
Explanation from Mujāhid 20

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on the words of God, Mighty and Majestic:
you will have no refuge that Day [al-Shura 47] meaning: "a safe place," and you will have no denial [nakir] [al-Shura 47] meaning: "no helper to take up your cause."

17

“or He makes them males and females”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 42:50).

21
Explanation from Mujāhid 21

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
or He makes them males and females [al-Shura 50] He says: "He mixes them in the pairing; He says: a woman bears a boy, then a girl, then a boy, then a girl."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا [الشورى: 50] يَقُولُ: " يُخْلَطُ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالتَّزْوِيجِ، يَقُولُ: تَلِدُ الْمَرْأَةُ غُلَامًا، ثُمَّ تَلِدُ جَارِيَةً، ثُمَّ تَلِدُ غُلَامًا، ثُمَّ تَلِدُ جَارِيَةً "
